LanguageData.FB_Psyphage.label: psyphage
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage.description: A heavy fleshbeast that can be ordered to swallow downed pawns, prisoners, slaves, and colonists. Victims are digested alive and their abilities are stored in its neural archive. It can also absorb psytrainers, psylink neuroformers, and anima trees, or root into flesh to become an immobile psyarchive.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage.tools.0.label: grinding maw
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage.tools.1.label: nerve lash
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive.label: psyarchive
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive.description:
A rooted psyphage that consumes a little hemogel. Downed pawns, psytrainers, and psylink neuroformers can be brought inside to expand its ability archive.

After it absorbs an anima tree, pawns accepted by the flesh colony can meditate here to grow anima growth. The growth lets them gain a psylink level with a random psycast, or an ability from the archive's slots.

The psyarchive can uproot and become mobile again, causing the growth to wither. Damage to the archive wounds the psyphage inside.
LanguageData.FB_PsyarchiveSoulGrowth.label: anima growth
LanguageData.FB_PsyarchiveSoulGrowth.description: Hollow fleshy growths that push out of the flesh around a psyarchive holding an absorbed anima tree while someone accepted by the flesh colony meditates nearby. Once enough have grown, such a colonist can link with the psyarchive for a psylink level or an archived ability; the growth withers when it uproots.
